title: LFM2.5 Q4_0 检查点：基于量化感知蒸馏的高效语言模型
summary: 本文介绍了 LiquidAI 发布的 LFM2.5 Q4_0 检查点，这些检查点是通过量化感知蒸馏（Quantization-Aware Distillation, QAD）技术从 LFM2.5 模型系列中生成的。QAD 结合了量化感知训练和知识蒸馏，在训练过程中同时优化模型权重和量化参数，使得模型在低比特（4-bit）量化下仍能保持较高的性能。文章详细阐述了 QAD 的原理，包括如何通过蒸馏损失函数将教师模型的知识传递给学生模型，并利用量化感知训练来减少量化误差。实验结果表明，LFM2.5 Q4_0 检查点在多个基准测试（如语言理解、推理和生成任务）上，与全精度模型相比，性能损失极小，同时显著降低了模型的内存占用和推理延迟，使其更适合在资源受限的设备上部署。此外，文章还提供了检查点的使用说明和性能对比数据，展示了 QAD 在保持模型质量的同时实现高效压缩的潜力。这一工作对于推动大语言模型在边缘计算和移动端的应用具有重要意义。
summary_en: This article introduces the LFM2.5 Q4_0 checkpoints released by LiquidAI, which are generated from the LFM2.5 model series using Quantization-Aware Distillation (QAD). QAD combines quantization-aware training and knowledge distillation, optimizing both model weights and quantization parameters during training, enabling the model to maintain high performance under 4-bit quantization. The article details the principles of QAD, including how distillation loss transfers knowledge from a teacher model to a student model and how quantization-aware training reduces quantization errors. Experimental results show that the LFM2.5 Q4_0 checkpoints exhibit minimal performance degradation compared to full-precision models across various benchmarks (e.g., language understanding, reasoning, and generation tasks), while significantly reducing memory footprint and inference latency, making them suitable for deployment on resource-constrained devices. The article also provides usage instructions and performance comparisons, highlighting the potential of QAD for efficient model compression without sacrificing quality. This work is significant for advancing large language model deployment in edge computing and mobile applications.
